items.prompt: We ___ football in the park yesterday.
items.explain: 'yesterday' يعني الماضي، فنستخدم past simple: play + ed = played.

items.prompt: She ___ a new phone last week.
items.explain: buy فعل شاذ، الماضي بتاعه bought مش buyed.

items.prompt: I ___ see him at the party.
items.explain: النفي في الماضي بيكون didn't + الفعل الأساسي (didn't see).

items.prompt: My brother is ___ than me.
items.explain: الصفة القصيرة بنزود عليها er + than: taller than. more tall غلط.

items.prompt: This is the ___ restaurant in town.
items.explain: superlative بتاع good هو best (شاذ). better للمقارنة بين اتنين بس.

items.prompt: Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
items.explain: لما نشوف دليل دلوقتي نتوقع بـ be going to + فعل: is going to rain.

items.prompt: You ___ wear a uniform at my school.
items.explain: I/you/we/they بياخدوا have to للإلزام. must ما بيجيش بعدها to.

items.point: much / many with countable and uncountable
items.prompt: How ___ water do you drink every day?
items.explain: water غير معدود فنستخدم much. many للمعدود.

items.prompt: The class starts ___ 9 o'clock.
items.explain: مع الساعة بنستخدم at (at 9 o'clock).

items.prompt: Be quiet! The baby ___.
items.explain: الحاجة اللي بتحصل دلوقتي بنستخدم لها be + verb-ing: is sleeping.

items.prompt: He ___ late for work.
items.explain: adverb of frequency بييجي بعد be: is never. وماينفعش نكرر النفي.

items.prompt: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
items.explain: للنصيحة: should + فعل من غير to.

items.prompt: ___ two books on the table.
items.explain: للجمع بنقول There are. There is للمفرد.

items.prompt: Can you help ___ with this bag?
items.explain: بعد الفعل بنحتاج object pronoun: help me.

items.prompt: When I was five, I ___ swim.
items.explain: بنتكلم عن الماضي، فـ could للقدرة في الماضي. can للحاضر.

items.prompt: It's ___ cold to go swimming today.
items.explain: too + adjective بتدي معنى سلبي (أكتر من اللازم): too cold to go.

items.prompt: We haven't got ___ milk.
items.explain: في النفي بنستخدم any. milk غير معدود فمش a ولا many.

items.prompt: I enjoy ___ to music in the evening.
items.explain: بعد enjoy الفعل بياخد -ing: enjoy listening.

items.prompt: They ___ married for ten years.
items.explain: for + مدة بتدل على حاجة لسه مستمرة، فنستخدم present perfect: have been.

items.prompt: I've never ___ a horse.
items.explain: بعد have/has بنحط past participle، وبتاع ride هو ridden.

items.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
items.explain: في first conditional بعد if بنستخدم present simple مش will: If it rains.

items.prompt: If I ___ more money, I would travel the world.
items.explain: في second conditional بعد if بنستخدم past simple: If I had.

items.prompt: This bridge ___ in 1990.
items.explain: الكوبري ما بنى نفسه، فنستخدم passive: was/were + past participle.

items.prompt: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
items.explain: للشخص كفاعل بنستخدم who. which للأشياء، whose للملكية.

items.prompt: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
items.explain: الحدث الطويل اللي كان شغال لما حاجة قطعته بياخد past continuous: was watching.

items.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ play in the street every day.
items.explain: للعادة القديمة بنقول used to + فعل. was/am used to معناها متعوّد على.

items.prompt: She decided ___ a new job.
items.explain: بعد decide بنستخدم to + فعل: decided to find.

items.prompt: You ___ park here. It's forbidden.
items.explain: mustn't معناها ممنوع. don't have to معناها مش لازم (مش ممنوع).

items.prompt: There are ___ people in the room, so we can start.
items.explain: enough بمعنى كفاية، وبتيجي قبل الاسم المعدود هنا.

items.prompt: The more you practise, ___ you become.
items.explain: التركيب: the + comparative ... the + comparative. better هي comparative بتاعة good.

items.prompt: It was ___ a good film that I watched it twice.
items.explain: such + a + adjective + noun. so بتيجي مع adjective لوحده (so good).

items.prompt: You're coming tonight, ___?
items.explain: الجملة مثبتة بـ are، فالـ tag منفي بنفس الفعل: aren't you.

items.prompt: She speaks English ___ than her brother.
items.explain: الـ adverb الطويل بياخد more: more fluently. more fluent صفة مش adverb.

items.prompt: I'm not very good ___ maths.
items.explain: good at هي الـ collocation الصح.

items.prompt: You can't enter the building ___ you have a ticket.
items.explain: unless معناها إلا لو (if not). If معناها هتقلب المعنى.

items.prompt: Could you tell me where ___?
items.explain: في السؤال غير المباشر الترتيب زي الجملة العادية: where the station is.

items.prompt: If I had known about the traffic, I ___ earlier.
items.explain: third conditional للماضي المستحيل تغييره: if + past perfect، وبعدها would have + past participle.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ more free time these days.
items.explain: wish للتمني عن الحاضر بياخد past simple: I wish I had.

items.prompt: He said he ___ the report the day before.
items.explain: في الـ reported speech بنرجع زمن ورا: finished بتبقى had finished.

items.prompt: She asked me ___ I had lived in London.
items.explain: السؤال غير المباشر ما فيهوش ترتيب سؤال ولا that: asked me how long I had lived.

items.prompt: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
items.explain: can't للاستنتاج السلبي القوي (مستحيل يكونوا). باقي الاختيارات مش للاستنتاج.

items.prompt: I can't find my wallet. I ___ it on the bus yesterday.
items.explain: استنتاج قوي عن الماضي: must have + past participle.

items.prompt: The house ___ at the moment, so we can't move in.
items.explain: البيت بيتدهن (ماحدش بيقول إنه بيدهن نفسه): is being + past participle.

items.prompt: The company is said ___ millions last year.
items.explain: last year حدث في الماضي، فنستخدم perfect infinitive: to have lost.

items.prompt: I'm exhausted. I ___ since six this morning.
items.explain: since + نقطة بداية والتعب نتيجة دلوقتي، فـ present perfect continuous: have been working.

items.prompt: My sister, ___ lives in Dubai, is visiting us.
items.explain: في non-defining بين فواصل مفيش that، ونستخدم who للشخص.

items.prompt: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
items.explain: حدثين في الماضي، اللي حصل الأول بياخد past perfect: had already started.

items.prompt: I'm looking forward ___ you next week.
items.explain: look forward to بعدها -ing لأن to هنا حرف جر.

items.prompt: By 2030, I ___ my degree.
items.explain: حاجة هتكون خلصت قبل وقت محدد في المستقبل: will have + past participle.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ harder for the exam last year.
items.explain: الندم على الماضي بيتعبر عنه بـ wish + past perfect.

items.prompt: I need to ___ my car serviced.
items.explain: have + object + past participle معناها حد تاني يعمل الشغل: have my car serviced.

items.prompt: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk.
items.explain: بعد although بييجي جملة كاملة. Despite بعدها اسم، وHowever جملة منفصلة.

items.prompt: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.
items.explain: as long as معناها بشرط إن. unless هتعكس المعنى.

items.prompt: I'll call you as soon as I ___ home.
items.explain: بعد as soon as بنستخدم present simple للمستقبل مش will.

items.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
items.explain: Not only في أول الجملة بتقلب الترتيب زي السؤال: did he arrive.

items.prompt: Rarely ___ such a beautiful view.
items.explain: Rarely في أول الجملة بتقلب الفاعل والمساعد: have I seen.

items.prompt: Hardly ___ the house when it started to rain.
items.explain: Hardly بعدها past perfect مقلوب: had we left ... when.

items.prompt: ___ you need any help, don't hesitate to ask.
items.explain: If you should need = Should you need. دي صيغة رسمية بدل if.

items.prompt: It was my manager ___ suggested the idea.
items.explain: it-cleft للتركيز على الشخص: It was X who ... ، وwhat مش بتتستخدم كده.

items.prompt: ___ I really need is a good night's sleep.
items.explain: wh-cleft بتبدأ بـ What: What I need is ...

items.prompt: If I had taken that job, I ___ in Singapore now.
items.explain: شرط في الماضي ونتيجة دلوقتي (mixed): if + past perfect, would + base verb.

items.prompt: The doctor insisted that he ___ rest for a week.
items.explain: بعد insist that في الطلب بنستخدم الـ base form (subjunctive): take.

items.prompt: The results were disappointing; ___, we plan to continue the project.
items.explain: المعنى فيه تناقض (نتايج وحشة بس هنكمل) فنستخدم nevertheless.

items.prompt: It's high time we ___ a decision.
items.explain: بعد it's (high) time بنستخدم past simple بمعنى الحاضر: made.

items.prompt: ___ the report, she went home.
items.explain: للحدث اللي خلص قبل التاني بنستخدم having + past participle.

items.prompt: There was ___ any traffic, so the journey was quick.
items.explain: hardly any معناها تقريباً مفيش. hard معناها بشدة.

items.prompt: So ___ that everyone left early.
items.explain: So + adjective في الأول بتقلب الترتيب: So boring was the lecture that ...

items.point: inverted third conditional (had it not been)
items.prompt: Had it not been for your help, I ___ the deadline.
items.explain: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for، والنتيجة would have + past participle.

items.prompt: He had his licence ___ for speeding.
items.explain: had + object + past participle: حد أخد الرخصة منه.

items.prompt: I was just about ___ out when the phone rang.
items.explain: be about to + فعل بمعنى كنت على وشك.

items.prompt: The number of students ___ increased significantly.
items.explain: the number of فاعلها مفرد (الرقم نفسه)، فنقول has increased.

items.prompt: She is entitled ___ a full refund.
items.explain: entitled to هي الـ collocation الصح.
